sourceScope: Only the seven frozen Markdown snapshots in inputs/cases.json. A no-evidence label means absent from this supplied corpus, not globally nonexistent.

adjudication.drift01: Answerable for the requested metadata classes and status effects; one reviewer marked partial because exact escalation thresholds are absent. Preserve that scope limitation and count the case as disagreement 2/3 versus 1/3.
adjudication.identity02: Paragraph 1 is sufficient for asked lineage authority; paragraph 2 is supplemental validation constraints, not required for this question.

requiredClaims: MSSR 0.2.18 removed active fallback to .bridge/ and requires explicit .mssr/ initialization.
The obsolete pre-0.2.18 runtime inbox is discarded, not migrated, due to potentially stale .bridge provenance.
taskKey is explicit host evidence.
Do not derive it from prose, workflowKey, similarity, recency, or inactivity.
parentTraceId and supersedesTraceId preserve lineage within a task.
They do not close, cancel, replace, validate, or mutate another trace.
The five first-party names have one canonical bundled source with reserved-name precedence.
The bundle does not load every skill on every task; activation remains explicit.
The 0.2.55 follow-up extends progressive disclosure to reference units.
Broad anomaly evidence loads a compact index; detailed procedure requires conjunctive stage and intent selectors.
Operational learning is external to model weights and remains observe-only.
Routing/context influence stays zero pending representative real data with repeatable net benefit and explicit reviewed flag, exploration floor, and instant rollback.
Shadow-rule gate: independent confirmed/corrected evidence, latest per family, default minimum 8 units from 2 projects, dominance 0.80, Wilson lower bound 0.65; relation contradictions excluded.
Fallback preference is separate: at least 24 independently verified holdout decisions, 4 truth-bearing projects, precision 0.95, coverage 0.25, zero wrong decisions.
Meeting preference gate allows advisory preference only; activation still needs reviewed flag, exploration floor, and rollback.
The evaluator combines trace stage, changed paths/tool categories, package/runtime adoption, routing/skill-structure changes, initialization/health, freshness conflicts, and user corrections.
WATCH is informational; REVIEW and REQUIRED activate maintenance.
labels.uncertainty: Exact mapping thresholds from each signal to WATCH/REVIEW/REQUIRED are not stated in the source.

requiredClaims: Integration is assessed through producer → evaluator → host consumer → notice/context surface → regression.
Exported code, tests, and roadmap checkboxes alone do not prove runtime adoption.
Freshness applies to explicitly declared current-state docs and exact host-observed refs; a later revision forces review.
review-due does not prove prose false; historical docs remain undeclared and no auto-edit occurs.
Each release declares PROJECT_CONTEXT, PROJECT_MEMORY, and PROJECT_STATE impact.
pending blocks persistence; reviewed-none is valid and updated corresponds to observed authority change.
